name: DICOM (PACS query)
description: Patient and exam details from each site's PACS by DICOM C-FIND (dcmtk's findscu): start a report from a recent CT/MR study, or — in a report's PACS tab — identify the study and patient it belongs to and fill what the report is missing. Query only: no images are retrieved and nothing listens on a port.

findscu.label: findscu (full path)
findscu.help: dcmtk ≥ 3.6.4; echoscu next to it tests the connection

modalities.label: Worklist modalities
modalities.help: DICOM codes: CT, MR, US, CR, DX, MG

search_window_days.label: PACS tab: days around the exam date
search_window_days.help: a report's PACS tab looks for its patient from this many days before to this many days after the exam date; 0 = that day only

query_by_patient.label: Search a report's PACS tab by patient
query_by_patient.help: sends the report's CNP or name to the site's PACS in a query file — never on a command line or in a URL. Off: date and modality only

servers.label: PACS per site
servers.help: leave the host empty for a site without a PACS; our AE title is how that PACS identifies us — each site its own. Test sends a C-ECHO with the saved values
